newsitem.title: USA: Burnham Pacific sets 5.5 mln share offer.
newsitem.headline: Burnham Pacific sets 5.5 mln share offer.

text.p: Burnham Pacific Tuesday said it agreed to sell 5.5 million shares of its common stock at $12.37 per share through underwriters led by Morgan Stanley & Co., Lehman Brothers, Merrill Lynch & Co. and EVEREN Securities.

The shares are being sold pursuant to a shelf registration statement. It's expected that the offering will close on Friday. Burnham Pacific also has granted the underwriters an option to purchase up to an additional 825,000 shares at the same offering price to cover over-allotments.
The proceeds will be used to reduce debt from the recent acquisitions of two shopping center portfolios. The company paid about $147 million for the assets.
Burnham Pacific acquires, rehabilitates, develops and manages retail properties in the Western U.S.
